_comment: Skips the modal 'IAP error' dialog. The Google Play billing service is not available offline, so Unity IAP always reports PurchasingUnavailable at startup. The game logs that and then shows a submit dialog; the dialog is informational (the title screen behind it stays interactive), but it has to be tapped away on every launch.

patches.reason: InAppPurchaseManager_UnityIAP$$OnInitializeFailed 0xFED2E2 -> epilogue 0xFED394: keep the Debug.LogError and the one-time init, skip DialogManager.SetLabelType/ShowSubmitDialog and the coroutine that drives the dialog.
